sample_arch.title: Sample agent architecture
sample_arch.body_copy_01:
Agent layer
The ibm_bob_assistant native agent is defined as a react_core agent in YAML and deployed via the orchestrate CLI. It references a Milvus-backed knowledge base containing 11 IBM Bob documentation files.

Knowledge base
ibm_bob_docs KB indexes 11 .txt files covering IBM Bob features, modes, skills, MCP, security, and telemetry. Content is chunked and vectorized on import.
sample_arch.body_copy_02:
Tool layer
Two @tool-decorated Python functions — search_bob_documentation and get_bob_doc_section — provide grounded retrieval against the KB. They enforce an allowlist of hostnames for SSRF protection.

Deploy pipeline
scripts/start.sh runs a 9-step idempotent pipeline: authenticate, import KB, poll readiness, import tools, import agent, deploy to Live, regenerate embed config.

sample_comps.title: Sample agent — component inventory
sample_comps.body_copy_01: agents/ibm_bob_assistant.agent.yaml — defines the agent, model, KB reference, and tool bindings. Deployed to eu-de.
sample_comps.body_copy_02: knowledge-bases/ibm_bob_docs.kb.yaml — references 11 .txt files. milvus indexes on import; poll until ready = true.
sample_comps.body_copy_03: tools/live_bob_search.py — defines search_bob_documentation and get_bob_doc_section. Imported via orchestrate CLI.
sample_comps.body_copy_04: scripts/get_webchat_embed.sh — fetches live embed IDs from wxO API and writes web/webchat-config.js.

orchestrate CLI deployment

python_arch.title: Production agent architecture
python_arch.body_copy_01:
scripts/import_tools.py and scripts/import_agent.py orchestrate the full import pipeline with JSON reports written to output/. Both scripts accept --force-reimport, --dry-run, and --verbose flags for CI/CD integration.

Exit codes: 0 = success, 1 = import failed, 2 = YAML invalid.
python_arch.body_copy_02:
requirements.txt pins orchestrate CLI, pyjwt >= 2.8.0, and cryptography >= 41.0.0. managed via uv venv + uv pip install.

Key env vars: orchestrate_url, ibm_cloud_api_key, orchestrate_env_name. never hard-coded — read from .env at startup.

Logs written to logs/ (gitignored content, tracked directory).

python_tools.title: Tool and script reference
python_tools.body_copy_01:
scripts/start.sh
Full 9-step idempotent deploy. Flags: --force-reimport, --skip-kb-check, --start-jwt-server

scripts/stop.sh
Undeploy agent + KB + stop JWT server. Flags: --keep-kb, --keep-agent
python_tools.body_copy_02:
scripts/import_tools.py
Imports @tool functions, validates, writes JSON report to output/

scripts/import_agent.py
Imports agent YAML with --force, --dry-run, --verbose, --no-log-file
python_tools.body_copy_03:
scripts/fetch_ibm_bob_docs.py
Refreshes KB .txt files from live Bob search API. requires bob_search_api_url and bob_search_api_token env vars.

Re-import KB after refresh: orchestrate knowledge-bases import -f kb.yaml

section_unsec.title: Unsecured embed chat
section_unsec.subtitle: Step-by-step integration, code patterns, and runtime
section_unsec.body_copy:
Zero-backend integration
Static HTML + generated config
Authentication toggle in wxO admin UI

unsec_stats.title: Unsecured embed — at a glance
unsec_stats.statistic_claim_01: Backend services required — serves entirely from static files
unsec_stats.statistic_claim_02: Config fields needed — orchestrationID, hostURL, agentId
unsec_stats.statistic_claim_03: Admin toggle to flip — embed security OFF in wxo tenant UI
unsec_stats.statistic_sources: Source: IBM watsonx Orchestrate embed documentation, project web/demo-unsecured.html

unsec_steps.title: Unsecured embed — setup in three steps
unsec_steps.body_copy_01:
Open your wxO tenant:
eu-de.watson-orchestrate.cloud.ibm.com

Navigate to:
Administration, settings, embed security

Toggle security: OFF and click save.

Without this step, all widget auth requests return HTTP 401 WXO-PROXY-10080E.
unsec_steps.body_copy_02:
Run the config generator:
bash scripts/get_webchat_embed.sh

This calls the wxO API with your IBM_CLOUD_API_KEY and writes web/webchat-config.js with live orchestrationID, hostURL, instanceUrl, agentId, and agentEnvironmentId.

Never edit webchat-config.js manually — regenerate it.
unsec_steps.body_copy_03:
Start the static web server:
python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory web

Open in browser:
http://localhost:8080

The wxo loader (wxoLoader.js) is fetched from the IBM CDN. the chat bubble appears bottom-right. click and type a test query to confirm end-to-end connectivity.

unsec_code.title: Unsecured embed — configuration and identifiers
unsec_code.body_copy_01:
Required configuration fields

orchestrationID — tenant + instance composite
hostURL — regional API base URL
Crn — IBM Cloud resource name
deploymentPlatform — ibmcloud
chatOptions.agentId — agent UUID
chatOptions.agentEnvironmentId — Live env UUID

The loader script (wxoLoader.js) is appended dynamically after the config is set. Call wxoLoader.init() in the script.onload handler.

webchat-config.js is generated by scripts/get_webchat_embed.sh on every start.sh run. Never edit it manually.
unsec_code.body_copy_02:
Identifiers are not secrets

The orchestrationid, agentid, and agentenvironmentid are client-visible identifiers. per IBM documentation, anyone with these ids can send messages and receive replies, but cannot log in to your account, modify the agent, or retrieve logs.

What IS secret — keep in .env only:
ORCHESTRATE_API_KEY
ORCHESTRATE_TOKEN (short expiry)
BOB_SEARCH_API_TOKEN

The RSA private key (secured embed only) must never appear in client-side code.

unsec_issues.title: Unsecured embed — troubleshooting
unsec_issues.body_copy_01:
Symptom: authentication error, agent fetching failed.
Cause: embed security toggle is ON (default state).
Fix: administration, settings, embed security, security: OFF, save.
unsec_issues.body_copy_02:
Symptom: No chat bubble appears.
Causes: webchat-config.js is stale; CSP blocks the wxO CDN; wrong hostURL region.
Fix: rerun get_webchat_embed.sh. check browser console for CSP or 404 errors.
unsec_issues.body_copy_03:
Symptom: Chat loads but queries return no relevant answers.
Cause: KB not yet Ready.
Fix: orchestrate knowledge-bases status -n ibm_bob_docs — wait for ready = true.

section_sec.title: Secured embed chat (JWT)
section_sec.subtitle: RSA signing, token lifecycle, and enterprise security
section_sec.body_copy:
RS256 asymmetric signing
RSA-2048 key pair
Short-lived tokens (max 7100 s)

sec_stats.title: Secured embed — key facts
sec_stats.statistic_claim_01: JWT signing algorithm — RSA-2048 asymmetric key pair; private key never leaves the server
sec_stats.statistic_claim_02: Maximum token lifetime enforced by IBM watsonx Orchestrate — default is 3600 s in jwt_server.py
sec_stats.statistic_claim_03: Setup steps — generate keys, upload public key, start JWT server, add identityToken callback
sec_stats.statistic_sources: Source: IBM watsonx Orchestrate secured embed documentation, scripts/jwt_server.py

sec_comps.title: JWT architecture — component roles
sec_comps.body_copy_01: Generates rsa-2048 key pair. outputs keys/wxo_embed_private.pem (chmod 600) and keys/wxo_embed_public.pem. non-interactive when called from start.sh.
sec_comps.body_copy_02: Python HTTP server on :3001. GET / (health), GET /api/token (anon JWT), POST /api/token (user JWT). RS256 via PyJWT. CORS enabled.
sec_comps.body_copy_03: Added to chatoptions. widget calls gettoken() on init and before token expiry. returns a raw rs256-signed JWT string to the wxo widget.
sec_comps.body_copy_04: Upload keys/wxo_embed_public.pem at administration, settings, embed security, security: ON. wxo verifies jwts against this key.

sec_jwt.title: JWT token lifecycle
sec_jwt.body_copy_01:
iss — ibm_bob_assistant_demo
sub — user ID or anonymous-<uuid8>
aud — watsonx-orchestrate
iat — issued-at Unix timestamp
exp — iat + JWT_EXPIRY_SECONDS
jti — UUID v4 (replay prevention)
name — display name (optional)

All fields follow the IBM watsonx Orchestrate JWT specification.
sec_jwt.body_copy_02:
1. Browser loads page with wxO widget script
2. wxoLoader.init() is called
3. Widget calls identityToken.getToken()
4. Browser fetches GET localhost:3001/api/token
5. jwt_server.py signs token with private key
6. Widget sends JWT to wxO auth endpoint
7. wxO verifies JWT with uploaded public key
8. Session established — chat is active
9. Widget auto-refreshes token before expiry
sec_jwt.body_copy_03:
EMBED_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE — path to PEM private key
JWT_SERVER_PORT — default 3001
JWT_EXPIRY_SECONDS — default 3600 (max 7100)
JWT_AUDIENCE — default watsonx-orchestrate
ALLOWED_ORIGINS — CORS allowlist

All vars read from .env at startup. Never hard-coded.

sec_issues.title: Secured embed — troubleshooting
sec_issues.body_copy_01:
Error: WXO-PROXY-10080E (kid not found)
Cause: public key not uploaded, or security toggle is OFF.
Fix: upload keys/wxo_embed_public.pem at administration, settings, embed security, security: ON.

Error: JWT server not reachable
Cause: jwt_server.py not running, or wrong port.
Fix: source venv/bin/activate && python scripts/jwt_server.py
Check: GET http://localhost:3001/ returns {status: ok}.

Error: Token expired immediately
Cause: JWT_EXPIRY_SECONDS exceeds 7100 (IBM hard limit).
Fix: set JWT_EXPIRY_SECONDS=3600 in .env.
sec_issues.body_copy_02:
Error: CORS blocked on /api/token
Cause: web page origin not in allowed_origins.
Fix: add page origin to allowed_origins in .env.
Example: ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:8080,https://myapp.example.com

Error: Private key not found at startup
Cause: EMBED_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE path is wrong or keys/ not generated.
Fix: Run bash scripts/generate_rsa_keys.sh.

Stop the JWT server
scripts/stop.sh uses lsof -ti tcp:3001 to find and kill the process. Manual: kill $(lsof -ti tcp:3001)

closing_stmt.title: From sample agent to production security
closing_stmt.quote: “The authentication error is not a code bug — it is a tenant configuration requirement. IBM watsonx orchestrate embed security is ON by default. toggle it OFF for quick integration, or sign jwts with an rsa-2048 key pair for enterprise-grade identity propagation.”
